limitations: This is a complete static semantic audit of the assigned current-source partition. Linux root/systemd/network/filesystem behavior, Windows native process behavior and real service integration were not executed or certified in this round; tests and probes were inspected as source only.

The pnpm dependency graph and locked integrity syntax were fully checked, but upstream package payloads, publisher provenance and registry vulnerability state were not downloaded or independently assessed.

go.sum does not encode external transitive manifest edges. This review verifies every recorded checksum and selected explicit go.mod/checksum closure, not a fresh upstream Go module graph resolution or cryptographic verification of downloaded modules.

Current feature-evidence documents explicitly describe earlier point-in-time and targeted results. Their old reports, prior audit evidence, WORKLOG, old implementation, Git history and .work reference targets were not opened, imported, rerun or used to establish this round clean.

The capability inventory stable/experimental labels were consumed and checked for internal count and pointer consistency; its historical independently generated stable schema was not opened. The current official generated request schema was read solely to check its 175 declared request pointers.
No conclusion of absence of all possible defects or live external account/service acceptance is made. No confirmed actionable finding was identified in the reviewed partition.

methodDetails.scope: Independently reviewed all 113 deployment and 63 tooling/docs files from the frozen round inventory. All 176 assigned files were completed; none sampled or substituted by filename/hash/grep inspection.
methodDetails.sourceReview: Read and semantically reviewed the complete text of all 173 ordinary implementation, test, configuration, CI, Go module, and current documentation/evidence files, in bounded full-output batches; any truncated output was reread in smaller complete ranges. Reviewed all deployment and tooling tests as code without running the suites. Read AGENTS.md and followed the explicit current user requirement of two successive independent clean rounds rather than its default three.
methodDetails.deployment: Traced root/native/control identities, filesystem ancestry and descriptor ownership, NOFOLLOW/link restrictions, credential endpoint binding and secret persistence, provider/layer lifecycle, fixed helper argv/IPC/request spools, locks/quota/replay fences, Git/index/ref/worktree capture and recovery, positive witness boundaries, Caddy DNS/build constraints, HTTPS prepare/activation/rollback/recovery and exact prior TLS/config/unit state, process stop verification and unknown outcomes, import archives and durable transaction ordering. Read positive, fault, root-only and cross-identity test fixtures and operational runbooks in full.
methodDetails.tooling: Traced affected versus full test admission, source-bound authorization and audit gate semantics, CI OS/identity separation, pinned Node/CLI/Go/native preparation, environment isolation, inventory snapshot and release scanner behavior, byte scanning and current exact historical allowlist declarations. Only current script source was read; history-scanning implementations were never executed and no old Git objects were viewed.
methodDetails.structuredData: Freshly authored .work/public-https-round24-deploy-tooling-data-check.mjs solely for this review; no older parser/report generator was consulted. Fully consumed fatal-UTF8 bytes of pnpm-lock.yaml (102516 bytes), deploy/caddy_dns_source/go.sum (151582 bytes), and capability-coverage.json (326262 bytes). JSON rejects duplicate keys and trailing bytes; the limited YAML grammar rejects unknown constructs, duplicate keys, invalid indentation and unsupported scalars rather than skipping. All recognized fields receive shape/type/value or graph checks. No structured data file was accepted on a sample.
methodDetails.pnpm: Validated all 3061 parsed nodes, importer pins against package.json, workspace overrides, 337 canonical SHA512 integrity values, every package/snapshot metadata field, all engine/platform/peer declarations, all 623 dependency and optional-dependency edges, and reachability of all 337 snapshots/packages from 22 direct roots. Read complete unique engine ranges and all peer declarations; fixed Node v24.22.1 meets the declared Node ranges. Dependency payloads were not downloaded.
methodDetails.go: Fully parsed every go.mod requirement and all 1545 go.sum records with duplicate refusal, explicit version grammar and canonical 32-byte h1 checksums. All 195 selected modules have both content and go.mod sums; additional sums across 625 module names remain explicit historical checksum data. Selected local module/checksum closure was verified without downloading upstream manifests.
methodDetails.capability: Fully consumed all 6297 parsed nodes, all 178 method records, 50 evidence groups, 15 extra workflows and 559 reference records. Validated duplicate-free identities, classifications/status counts, method/group backreferences and all 175 official current ClientRequest JSON pointers. Read every method/params/schema/public-alias binding and all descriptive text; the 178 method assessments were verified identical to their fully read group assessments. References were classified against the frozen inventory; 532 current-source references and 27 historical references were identified. The 240 point-in-time hash drifts in current-path references remain historical evidence and were not treated as current source acceptance. No historical reference target was opened.
methodDetails.boundaries: At actual start and finish independently calculated raw SHA256 for every one of the complete 1911-file inventory, with zero mismatches, and separately executed the fixed Node v24.22.1 scripts/snapshot.mjs at both boundaries. Both snapshots returned exactly 1911 files and the frozen digest. Source files were not changed. Only new ignored .work validator/proof/report artifacts were written.
methodDetails.execution: No product test suite, targeted test, live service, deployment, paid inference, external provider or credential action was executed. Only read-only source/inventory inspection, fixed snapshot calls and local isolated data validation ran.
